_comment: Batch 010 -- the dressing the generator actually places.
The stack shot is the one that matters for the drum: _theme_props
duplicates it at +0.95 four times in ten, so the only way to know the
mesh tiles is to stand two of them on each other and look.

shots.name: D_drum_stack
shots.caption: OIL DRUM, SINGLE AND STACKED - THE ENGINE DUPLICATES IT AT +0.95
shots.note: THE BUNG IS FLUSH, NOT PROUD: A 20 MM BOSS BREAKS EVERY STACK

shots.name: D_valve_wheel
shots.caption: WALL VALVE - THE NARROW-CORRIDOR PROP, 0.24 M OFF THE WALL
shots.note: A RIM ON SIX SPOKES. A SOLID DISC IS A DINNER PLATE ON A WALL

shots.name: D_wall_plate
shots.caption: BOLTED WARNING PLATE - THE ONLY DRESSING A FACILITY ZONE GETS
shots.note: SO IT CARRIES ALL OF 'SOMEBODY WORKED HERE': FRAME, BOLTS, A FOLD

shots.name: D_dressing_family
shots.caption: THREE OF SIX - FACILITY PLATE, RUSTED DRUM, RUSTED VALVE
shots.note: GOTHIC, NEON AND TEMPLE WAIT ON THEIR THEME MATERIAL FAMILIES
